app.title: Smart Smoker Push Experiment
app.instructions: Development test only. On iPhone, add this HTTPS page to the Home Screen and open its icon first. Paste only the development VAPID PUBLIC key. Keep the exported subscription private; transfer it using an encrypted owner-controlled channel. This page never contacts your smoker.
app.output: Private export: select and copy into the publisher's private file

status.unsupported: Push is unavailable here. Use a trusted HTTPS origin and a supported browser; on iPhone, open the installed Home Screen app.
status.ready: Ready. Enter the public key and register with the button.
status.existing: An existing subscription was found. Export it, or remove it before changing VAPID keys.
status.registered: Registered. Export the subscription for the development publisher.
status.denied: Permission was not granted. Review browser and system notification settings before retrying.
status.failed: Operation failed. Check the public key, permissions, network and browser support. Private values are hidden.
status.exported: Private subscription exported below. After changing language, export and transfer again.
status.removed: Subscription removed. Delete its old private publisher file too.

notification.title: Smart Smoker — push test
notification.body: Test {{id}} sent at {{time}}. Development publisher; no real temperature alert.
notification.fallback: A development push arrived with an empty or invalid test payload.
